findings.evidence: The request set no thinking level, so a model whose default is thinking-on could spend the answer budget on reasoning. The thinking REST field could not be verified on ai.google.dev.
findings.why_it_matters: Thinking tokens count against maxOutputTokens; every answer could end TRUNCATED, FAILED and refunded.
findings.resolution: No unverified field is sent. ChatGeminiConfig refuses any model outside the gemini-2.5-flash-lite family at startup (message names the model, never the key); the Javadoc records the 2026-10-28 check; ChatGeminiModelGuardTest covers it.

findings.evidence: The class Javadoc did not record which request fields were verified against the vendor docs.
findings.why_it_matters: The vendor request shape is a non-obvious external contract.
findings.resolution: Javadoc now lists the fields, the check date and why the thinking field is not sent.

findings.evidence: The prompt allowed unbounded long-text corrections while max-tokens is 800.
findings.why_it_matters: A long correction could end TRUNCATED, wasting a refunded call.
findings.required_action: If measured truncation stays high in the Phase 5 prompt suite, revisit chat.ai.max-tokens.
findings.resolution: The prompt bounds corrections (about 350 words, at most five errors, changed parts only, Vietnamese token warning); ChatPromptsScopeTest checks the wording.

findings.evidence: A candidate without finishReason was treated as success.
findings.why_it_matters: A cut-off answer could be shown or cached.
findings.resolution: Only STOP is a normal end; a missing or blank finishReason is INVALID_RESPONSE with usage kept; GeminiChatClientFinishReasonTest covers it.

findings.evidence: The answer length 20000 was a literal in the parser and both entities.
findings.why_it_matters: A drifting value makes a paid answer fail at the final insert.
findings.resolution: ChatConstants.MAX_ANSWER_CHARS feeds the parser and both entities; ChatAnswerLimitTest pins it; the SQL literal is covered by the Postgres schema tests.

findings.evidence: 'opinions' and 'real exam' wording could refuse legitimate PTE questions.
findings.why_it_matters: A refusal is free but useless to the student.
findings.required_action: None. Real model behaviour is measured in the Phase 5 prompt suite.
findings.resolution: Wording narrowed; practice model answers, templates and essay feedback explicitly allowed. ChatPrompts.VERSION stays v1 because chat is flag-gated off and no v1 answer has been cached anywhere; bump it if any has.

findings.evidence: expiresAt is optional and null by default; the cache table grows with distinct questions.
findings.why_it_matters: No TTL or size bound by default.
findings.required_action: Revisit eviction when table growth is measured.

findings.evidence: The send/timeout/status-classification logic duplicates the shape of scoring's GeminiRestClient.
findings.required_action: Re-evaluate extraction if a third Gemini client appears.
findings.resolution: Accepted by AD-03 (separate chat and scoring clients).

findings.evidence: ChatService must refund on any RuntimeException from generate, not only ChatAiException.
findings.why_it_matters: An unexpected runtime failure must not consume a quota unit.

findings.evidence: markdown_content is returned unmodified; only the prompt asks for no HTML or images.
findings.why_it_matters: Model output is untrusted; the renderer must neutralise it.
findings.resolution: Done in Phase 4 (react-markdown, skipHtml, images blocked, link scheme allowlist).

findings.evidence: ChatGeminiConfig relies on ChatAiProperties registered by ChatAiConfig; both gated by the same switch.
findings.resolution: Documented in the Javadoc; stays NOTED.
